latest_release.name: Minus v2.0.0 - Major changes and new features
latest_release.body:
### While I'm trying to keep Minus as updated as possible, seems like most features are already into the app.

Thanks to all the users that keep using Minus as your budget tracker, 25k+ users, active 1k on google play means a lot...

Please if you find anything not working properly don't hesitate to report it back and I'll try to fix it as soon as possible.

## What's new

- feat: implement media showcase into changelog
- feat: category concat when detected calculation
- feat: add category limits feature and settings
- feat: add a reminder to save calculated amount on period start
- feat: enhance category suggestion by usage and recurrence
- ci: add unit tests and report uploads to PR check workflow
- feat: update expanded island brief component
- feat: update tile functionality to add expenses on the go
- feat: add launcher shortcuts for receipt scanner
- feat: add receipt scanning with camera and OCR
- feat: add AZN currency
- fix: account for recurring payments on analytics

## What's Changed
* fix: account for recurring payments on analytics by @isaacsa51 in https://github.com/isaacsa51/Minus/pull/317
* feat: ML receipt scanner implementation by @isaacsa51 in https://github.com/isaacsa51/Minus/pull/320

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/isaacsa51/Minus/compare/v1.10.1...v2.0.0
